name: Notification of Field Trip Plan Changes
description: When an approved trip's plans change, the listed persons are notified.
recipient: Requesting teacher, approving principal, Assistant Superintendent, Supervisor of Transportation
quote: When plans for an approved trip change for any reason, the following persons are to be notified as soon as possible: the teacher requesting the trip, the principal approving the trip, the Assistant Superintendent, and the Supervisor of Transportation.
